parameters.name: Engine
parameters.description:
The database engine. Valid values:

*   **MySQL**: ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL
*   **PolarDBMySQL**: PolarDB for MySQL
*   **PostgreSQL**: ApsaraDB RDS for PostgreSQL

parameters.name: SqlId
parameters.description: The SQL template ID. You can call the [GetQueryOptimizeDataStats](~~405261~~) operation to query the SQL template ID.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun das get-query-optimize-tag --engine MySQL --sql-id 29d9fef63e347d39c3436658a5fe0000 --instance-id rm-2ze8g2am976240000 --region cn-hangzhou
